rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_cmi_summary_region (
	`id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	`hospcode` VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
	`areacode` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
	`flag_sent` VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL,
	`date_com` VARCHAR(17) DEFAULT NULL,
	`b_year` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
	`region` VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
	`chwcode` VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
	`sumcase` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjrw` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`splevel` VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`refcmi` DECIMAL(11,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`pctlowcmi` DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm10` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm10` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm11` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm11` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm12` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm12` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm01` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm01` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm02` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm02` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm03` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm03` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm04` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm04` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm05` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm05` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm06` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm06` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm07` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm07` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm08` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm08` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm09` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm09` DECIMAL(12,4) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntok` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;


DELETE FROM s_cmi_summary_region WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cmi_summary_region 
(id, hospcode, areacode, flag_sent, date_com, b_year, region, chwcode, sumcase, sumadjrw, splevel, refcmi, pctlowcmi
		, cntm10, sumadjm10, cntm11, sumadjm11, cntm12, sumadjm12, cntm01, sumadjm01, cntm02, sumadjm02, cntm03, sumadjm03
		, cntm04, sumadjm04, cntm05, sumadjm05, cntm06, sumadjm06, cntm07, sumadjm07, cntm08, sumadjm08, cntm09, sumadjm09
		, cntok)
(select @id as id, t.hospcode
	, concat(h.provcode, h.distcode, h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	, @send as flag_sent, DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as date_com, @b_year+543 as b_year
	, t.region, t.chwcode
	, sum(t.cntan) as sumcase, sum(t.sumadj) as sumadjrw
	, t.splevel, t.refcmi, t.pctlowcmi
	, sum(t.cntm10) as cntm10, sum(t.adjm10) as sumadjm10
	, sum(t.cntm11) as cntm11, sum(t.adjm11) as sumadjm11
	, sum(t.cntm12) as cntm12, sum(t.adjm12) as sumadjm12
	, sum(t.cntm01) as cntm01, sum(t.adjm01) as sumadjm01
	, sum(t.cntm02) as cntm02, sum(t.adjm02) as sumadjm02
	, sum(t.cntm03) as cntm03, sum(t.adjm03) as sumadjm03
	, sum(t.cntm04) as cntm04, sum(t.adjm04) as sumadjm04
	, sum(t.cntm05) as cntm05, sum(t.adjm05) as sumadjm05
	, sum(t.cntm06) as cntm06, sum(t.adjm06) as sumadjm06
	, sum(t.cntm07) as cntm07, sum(t.adjm07) as sumadjm07
	, sum(t.cntm08) as cntm08, sum(t.adjm08) as sumadjm08
	, sum(t.cntm09) as cntm09, sum(t.adjm09) as sumadjm09
	, sum(t.cntok) as sumok
from t_cmi_admission t join chospital h on t.hospcode = h.hoscode
group by t.hospcode
);

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: select h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name, sum(sumcase) as total, sum(sumcase)-sum(cntok) as err 		, sum(cntok) as target1 , sum(sumadjrw) as result1 , ROUND((sum(sumadjrw)/sum(cntok)),4) as p 		, sum(sumadjm10) as sm10, sum(cntm10) as m10, sum(sumadjm11) as sm11, sum(cntm11) as m11 		, sum(sumadjm12) as sm12, sum(cntm12) as m12, sum(sumadjm01) as sm01, sum(cntm01) as m01 		, sum(sumadjm02) as sm02, sum(cntm02) as m02, sum(sumadjm03) as sm03, sum(cntm03) as m03 		, sum(sumadjm04) as sm04, sum(cntm04) as m04, sum(sumadjm05) as sm05, sum(cntm05) as m05 		, sum(sumadjm06) as sm06, sum(cntm06) as m06, sum(sumadjm07) as sm07, sum(cntm07) as m07 		, sum(sumadjm08) as sm08, sum(cntm08) as m08, sum(sumadjm09) as sm09, sum(cntm09) as m09  from chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s on h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}})  and  (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}}) and h.hdc_regist=1 and h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) and h.hoscode in ( select hoscode from  ccmihosp where byear = {{YEAR}} AND ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) )  GROUP BY h.hoscode,concat(h.hoscode  order by h.hoscode

cup.query: select m.hmain as a_code ,concat('CUP:',m.hmainname) as a_name, sum(sumcase) as total, sum(sumcase)-sum(cntok) as err 		, sum(cntok) as target1 , sum(sumadjrw) as result1 , ROUND((sum(sumadjrw)/sum(cntok)),4) as p 		, sum(sumadjm10) as sm10, sum(cntm10) as m10, sum(sumadjm11) as sm11, sum(cntm11) as m11 		, sum(sumadjm12) as sm12, sum(cntm12) as m12, sum(sumadjm01) as sm01, sum(cntm01) as m01 		, sum(sumadjm02) as sm02, sum(cntm02) as m02, sum(sumadjm03) as sm03, sum(cntm03) as m03 		, sum(sumadjm04) as sm04, sum(cntm04) as m04, sum(sumadjm05) as sm05, sum(cntm05) as m05 		, sum(sumadjm06) as sm06, sum(cntm06) as m06, sum(sumadjm07) as sm07, sum(cntm07) as m07 		, sum(sumadjm08) as sm08, sum(cntm08) as m08, sum(sumadjm09) as sm09, sum(cntm09) as m09  from cmastercup as m  join chospital_regis as h on m.hospcode5= h.hoscode  join ccmihosp as ch on ch.byear = {{YEAR}} and ch.hcode = m.hospcode5 LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s on h.hoscode=m.hospcode5 AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code ={{PROVINCE_CODE}}  or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}})  and  (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}}) and h.hdc_regist=1 and ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   GROUP BY m.hmain,concat('CUP:'  order by h.hoscode

service_plan_hospital.query: select h.hoscode as a_code ,CONCAT(m.splevel,':',h.hosname) as a_name, sum(sumcase) as total, sum(sumcase)-sum(cntok) as err 		, sum(cntok) as target1 , sum(sumadjrw) as result1 , ROUND((sum(sumadjrw)/sum(cntok)),4) as p 		, sum(sumadjm10) as sm10, sum(cntm10) as m10, sum(sumadjm11) as sm11, sum(cntm11) as m11 		, sum(sumadjm12) as sm12, sum(cntm12) as m12, sum(sumadjm01) as sm01, sum(cntm01) as m01 		, sum(sumadjm02) as sm02, sum(cntm02) as m02, sum(sumadjm03) as sm03, sum(cntm03) as m03 		, sum(sumadjm04) as sm04, sum(cntm04) as m04, sum(sumadjm05) as sm05, sum(cntm05) as m05 		, sum(sumadjm06) as sm06, sum(cntm06) as m06, sum(sumadjm07) as sm07, sum(cntm07) as m07 		, sum(sumadjm08) as sm08, sum(cntm08) as m08, sum(sumadjm09) as sm09, sum(cntm09) as m09  from (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp where byear = {{YEAR}} ) as m LEFT JOIN s_kpi_childdev4 AS s ON m.hcode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} left join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}})  and  (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}}) and h.hdc_regist=1 and ( m.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})   GROUP BY h.hoscode,CONCAT(m.splevel  order by h.hoscode

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: select h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum(sumcase) as total, sum(sumcase)-sum(cntok) as err 		, sum(cntok) as target1 , sum(sumadjrw) as result1 , ROUND((sum(sumadjrw)/sum(cntok)),4) as p 		, sum(sumadjm10) as sm10, sum(cntm10) as m10, sum(sumadjm11) as sm11, sum(cntm11) as m11 		, sum(sumadjm12) as sm12, sum(cntm12) as m12, sum(sumadjm01) as sm01, sum(cntm01) as m01 		, sum(sumadjm02) as sm02, sum(cntm02) as m02, sum(sumadjm03) as sm03, sum(cntm03) as m03 		, sum(sumadjm04) as sm04, sum(cntm04) as m04, sum(sumadjm05) as sm05, sum(cntm05) as m05 		, sum(sumadjm06) as sm06, sum(cntm06) as m06, sum(sumadjm07) as sm07, sum(cntm07) as m07 		, sum(sumadjm08) as sm08, sum(cntm08) as m08, sum(sumadjm09) as sm09, sum(cntm09) as m09  from chospital_regis as h  INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s on h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} where (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{MINISTRY_CODE}}) and (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) and (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}})  and  (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}}) and (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_CODE}} or  'ALL'={{DISTRICT_CODE}}) and h.hoscode in ( select hoscode from  ccmihosp where byear = {{YEAR}} AND ( splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}  or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) )   GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name  order by h.zone_code
